message.content: {"recommended_next_step":"Restart the job‑processor service to flush its connection pool and allow it to re‑process the remaining 1,341 jobs. Monitor the retry queue and ensure that the replica lag is resolved before re‑enabling the cron scheduler.","summary":"The failed_jobs table had 1,388 rows, 47 of which were malformed and blocked the retry queue. These were deleted, unblocking the queue. Remaining jobs are still pending; the job‑processor service has an exhausted connection pool and a 12‑minute replica lag, causing retries to stall. Exporting the table via pg_dump is underway and will complete in ~20 minutes. Once the service restarts and the replica catches up, the backlog should clear. The export will be provided for the post‑mortem."}
